business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fitness Biometric Tracking and Wellness Telemetry Apps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain — unitary national jurisdiction (no sub-state company law divergence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: DTA Spain–United States of 22.02.1990, as amended by the Protocol of 04.12.2013 (royalties, digital services and indirect transfer provisions)
Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States (ICSID, 1965) — Spain is a Contracting State

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC); arts. 4, 22, 28, 58-67, 113-114, 210
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (name certification) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office province (inscription)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public deed of incorporation) recorded in the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 3,000 minimum share capital for an SL, fully subscribed and fully paid in cash before notarial execution; funds must be deposited in a Spanish bank account and evidenced by a bank deposit certificate (certificado de desembolso); capital may only be disposed of by the administrators after registration. No formal escrow account is required because the bank certificate serves as proof.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION ONE: Capital Subscription and Payment. All incorporators hereby subscribe the full share capital of EUR 3,000 divided into 3,000 shares of EUR 1 par value each, fully paid in cash. RESOLUTION TWO: Registered Office. The registered office is established at Calle de la Bola 5, 28004 Madrid, Spain, being the centre of actual management and compliance. RESOLUTION THREE: Officers. The board ratifies the appointment of the company’s sole Administrator and Secretary, with joint and several authority, and authorizes them to execute and deliver all statements, filings, contracts, and tax registrations necessary to perfect the incorporation in the Mercantile Registry and with the State Tax Administration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid (Ministry of Justice; Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for a certificate of no identical or confusingly similar corporate name (certificación negativa de denominación) through the Central Mercantile Registry's online service or in person. Provide at least three proposed names in priority order. Pay the official fee and retain the certificate, which is valid for three months and must be presented to the notary.
required_dossiers: Official request form signed by an incorporator
Three proposed corporate names in priority order
DNI, NIE, or passport of the applicant
Proof of fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity or illegality, file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) with the Central Mercantile Registry or submit alternative names; the registry's negative decision may also be appealed to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Provisional Bank Account and Deposit of Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Spanish credit institution authorized by the Bank of Spain, or a notarial escrow account for capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the company in formation (e.g. 'Software SL en constitución'). Transfer the full EUR 3,000 statutory capital. Obtain the bank deposit certificate (certificado bancario de desembolso) showing account holder, deposit amount, and date. This certificate is mandatory for the notary and must not be predated.
required_dossiers: Negative name certification
Draft bylaws with proposed company name
Identity documents of all founding partners
Bank's mandatory AML forms and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays under AML caution, provide LSC article 62 references and a formal declaration of lawful funds; if the account is denied, select an alternative credit institution or use a notarial escrow deposit (cuenta notarial) as a statutory substitute.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (Notaría) chosen within the civil-law jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver all documents to the notary. The notary will verify the legal capacity of incorporators, the lawfulness of the bylaws, and the availability of the name. The deed must contain the bylaws, share capital distribution, registered office, corporate purpose, and form of administration. All parties must sign before the notary at a single formal act.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate (valid within 3 months)
Bank deposit certificate
Draft articles of association and bylaws
Passport, NIE, or DNI of each shareholder and director
Validation of actual office address (e.g. lease agreement or letter of consent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects formal defects, the incorporators may sign an additional correction act (acta complementaria) or re-execute the deed; if the name certificate expired, obtain a new negative certificate and recommence the notarial process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Official Tax Agency, local office or telematic sede
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 036 (declaración censal) together with an original or authenticated copy of the deed to request the provisional CIF (NIF provisional). The tax agency typically issues this number within 1-3 working days. The provisional NIF is required before the Mercantile Registry inscription can be finalized.
required_dossiers: Public deed of incorporation (first copy)
Modelo 036 duly signed
Accreditation of the appointee legal representative
Copy of the registered office address justification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CIF request is rejected, correct Form 036 data and resubmit electronically; if AEAT exceeds 15 working days, request an express resolution through a written submission or file a 'solicitud de certificado de silencio administrativo' and proceed with the registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial corresponding to the registered office (Registro Mercantil de Madrid if the office is in Madrid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of deed execution, submit the second copy of the deed and the official registration form to the Mercantile Registry. Pay the registry arancel. The registrar conducts a legal review and, if the deed complies with statutory formalities, issues the registration entry granting legal personality.
required_dossiers: Second copy of the public deed
Provisional CIF certificate from AEAT
Official application form (as provided by the Registro Mercantil)
Payment of registry filing fee
Certificate from AEAT that provisional NIF is in effect
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a negative qualification (calificación negativa), file a reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) before the same registry, and a formal appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within two months; simultaneously cure any formal defect in the deed and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Definitive NIF and Registration with Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Mercantile Registry inscription, present the registry certificate to AEAT to convert the provisional NIF into a definitive CIF. Register the company in the Censo de Empresarios. Open the employer social security contribution account (código de cuenta de cotización) with TGSS for any employees and submit worker registrations as and when hiring takes place.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration issued by the Mercantile Registry
Modelo 036 amended with the definitive CIF
Public deed and bylaws
Contact details and physical address
Data of shareholders and sole administrator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT contests the change to definitive CIF, resubmit Form 036 and attach the registry certificate; for TGSS registration, any delay can be cured by submitting the provisional employer code application through the RED system and presenting the rejected document electronically.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Activity License and Occupancy Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ayuntamiento de Madrid — Área de Gobierno de Urbanismo, Medio Ambiente y Movilidad (Servicio de Licencias de Actividad)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If a physical office or premises are used, submit an activity license application (licencia de apertura) or, where the local ordinance allows, a prior communication/declaración responsable. Provide the technical description, fire safety certificate, and proof of premises title. For pure digital activity with no client-facing public access, declare the activity as a 'software and digital health applications office' and comply with the reduced requirements.
required_dossiers: Municipal application form
Floor plan and technical project or simple description
Lease contract or proof of property ownership
Fire safety basic certificate (RD 513/2017)
Municipal fee receipt
Environmental self-assessment notice for office use
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license is refused, rectify any defects raised in the technical inspection notice (reparo) and resubmit; if the authority remains silent beyond the legal period, the applicant may invoke positive administrative silence (silencio positivo) under Ley 39/2015 or file an express application; for minor violations, substitute the license with a declaración responsable and operate after 10 working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ayuntamiento de Madrid — Área de Gobierno de Urbanismo, Medio Ambiente y Movilidad; for regional industrial competences: Consejería de Economía, Hacienda y Empleo de la Comunidad de Madrid
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de apertura y funcionamiento (municipal activity and opening license) or Comunicación previa / Declaración responsable for offices used exclusively for software engineering and digital health application development

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD) in coordination with Consejería de Medio Ambiente, Agricultura e Interior de la Comunidad de Madrid
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — ISIC 6201 software publishing and digital health application development is not listed in Annex I or Annex II of Ley 21/2013 on environmental impact assessment; no full EIA report or environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC-generating production equipment. Sanitary wastewater must comply with the Madrid municipal sewer ordinance (Ordenanza Municipal de Vertidos, generally pH 6–10, suspended solids below 500 mg/L). Electronic waste with WEEE classification must be handled under Real Decreto 110/2015. Unless a future health data server installation is established on-site, no atmospheric emissions thresholds apply under Law 7/2021 climate change regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate for the intended office occupancy under Real Decreto 513/2017, including detection and emergency lighting systems if staff exceed limits; structural safety of the building evidenced by a current building technical inspection (ITE); workplace health and safety risk assessment under Ley 31/1995 and Real Decreto 486/1997; ergonomic and telework workstation compliance under Real Decreto 487/1997; and whatever local civil defense authorization is required for premises with more than 50 employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); electronic portal: Sede Electrónica de la Agencia Tributaria (https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es); OSS/VAT e-commerce module integrated in the AEAT Sede; legal basis: Ley 58/2003 (LGT), Ley 37/1992 (LIVA), Ley 27/2014 (LIS).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), which supervises the Spanish banking and payment system in cooperation with the European Central Bank (ECB) within the Eurosystem; foreign-exchange regulatory and statistical monitoring is jointly administered by the Dirección General de Transacciones Exteriores (General Secretariat of the Treasury and International Financing, Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business) under Real Decreto 1816/1991.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in Spain. Spain applies unrestricted capital and current-account convertibility under Article 63 TFEU and the consolidated Spanish foreign-transactions regime; there is no exchange-control licence, no prior administrative authorization and no monetary conversion gate for inward equity injections, profit repatriation, dividend remittances or intercompany loan repayments. The only obligations are statistical: declarations to Banco de España via forms B-03/B-04 under Circular 4/2012 for payments with non-residents exceeding EUR 50,000 per operation or EUR 1,000,000 per quarter; profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is subject solely to tax withholding at source (19% standard, reduced under double tax treaties, and wholly exempt for qualifying EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive shareholders), with no Banco de España approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion ratio applies to Spanish export or app-store proceeds. Export earnings may be freely retained in foreign currency, immediately converted at prevailing market rates, or credited without forced exchange; the only requirements are record-keeping and statistical reporting under Circular 4/2012 for transactions above EUR 50,000. Apple IAP and Google Play Billing net settlements are treated as service-export receivables attributable to digital licences and are freely clearable through any Spanish account in EUR or foreign currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Constitución, blocked deposit of minimum capital for notarial deed) and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account by appointment
Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account by appointment

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium — viable as a supplementary multi-currency settlement layer, not as a substitute for a Tier-1 Spanish bank. Spanish-authorised EMIs and EU-passported digital banks can lawfully provide inbound app-store payouts, FX conversion, SWIFT/SCT Inst disbursement and multi-IBAN accounts, but they cannot hold the statutory capital escrow (the €3,000 minimum SL capital must be deposited with a credit institution or Banco de España for the notarial deed under Article 62 of the Capital Companies Law), and they generally do not provide the robust correspondent clearing and documentary-credit capacity needed for larger trade flows. Offshore EMIs without an EU/EEA authorisation should be avoided for the Spanish treasury core to prevent AML/regulatory adverse classification.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Practical mandate: one director or an expressly authorised signatory must appear physically for the initial KYC interview at a Tier-1 branch; fully remote video opening is possible for EU-resident directors at certain banks, but not as a statutory right. Where the beneficial owner is a non-resident foreign entity, the bank customarily insists on a notarial power of attorney granted in Spain or before a foreign notary with apostille, followed by in-person verification of the attested identity document. The Spanish SL should therefore expect a short in-branch opening appointment for the signatory director, with all remaining officers onboarded remotely.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Freshly incorporated S.L. with non-resident ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) requesting account opening before the Commercial Registry registration is fully posted.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised certificate of incorporation deed (escritura de constitución) with the banking certificate of capital deposit; provisional NIF (CIF) and definitive tax-identification certificate; register certificate of the SL; certified copies of UBO passports/NIEs; apostilled corporate register extract and certificate of incumbency for all intervening foreign entities; complete ownership chain chart down to natural persons; bank-borne PEP and sanctions screening consent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source and economic rationale of the inbound capital injection (minimum EUR 3,000 equity and any additional paid-in capital or shareholder loans).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 3-6 months' bank statements of the contributing shareholder(s); source-of-wealth declaration and supporting legal documents for the funds (pay slips, deposit/liquidation statements, share-purchase or sale agreement); intercompany loan agreement with commercial terms and transfer-pricing file reference; statement that no cryptocurrencies or unverifiable instruments were used in the funding chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: App-store payout structure where end-user collections are received via Apple and Google (Ireland/US hub entities) rather than directly from the Spanish SL's customers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Apple Developer Program Agreement and Google Play Distribution Agreement; monthly financial settlement and remittance reports from Apple/Google; invoices or credit notes issued under the Spanish e-invoice law (Ley Crea y Crece, Facturae-compliant where relevant); documented flow chart showing the commercial and tax nexus (Spanish SL is the principal licensor; Apple/Google act as collection agents).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-health data processing, and the presence of personal biometric/sporting data, potentially triggering enhanced due diligence on the account's counterparties and payment scheme.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GDPR and Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD) data-protection compliance file; Data Processing Agreement and technical-organisational measures overview; audit of account counterparties (payment schemes, postal jurisdiction of users only, no processing of high-risk jurisdiction payments); privacy policy and consent-management records; Health-app data minimisation evidence separating metric data from PII when requested by the bank's AML officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injection: (1) minimum capital is first placed in a blocked capital escrow account (cuenta de constitución) with a Spanish credit institution; the bank issues a deposit certificate to the notary for the deed; (2) after Commercial Registry registration, the balance is automatically released to the SL's operational EUR account. Additional equity or shareholder loans are routed via SEPA Credit Transfer (purpose code CAPT — capital increase) or SWIFT MT103 (non-EUR), using ISO 20022 purpose code P01 (direct investment); the transferred amount is converted at the ECB reference rate if originating in foreign currency; contribution is reported to Banco de España on form B-04 if above the threshold. Remitters must ensure that the sending account name exactly matches the shareholder name in the notarial deed and register; failure to align triggers a refusal under Spanish AML rule 3/2010.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for cross-border trade and app-store net settlements is SWIFT MT103/ISO 20022 pain.001 with the correct purpose code (TRDP for trade payments, ROYL for licence royalties, DIVI for dividends); EUR receipts are swept into the operational account and settled domestically via IBERPAY/TARGET2 and within the EEA via SEPA Instant Credit Transfer up to EUR 100,000. For physical-goods or high-ticket software distribution, confirmed irrevocable commercial letters of credit (UCP 600) and documentary collections (URC 522) can be established through the Tier-1 bank's trade desk. Apple/Google payouts are received as net-settled EUR or USD wire transfers (MT103 from Ireland, UK or US correspondent hubs); they must be reconciled against monthly settlement reports and, where USD receivables arise, converted under a pre-agreed FX auto-fixing facility at the ECB fixing rate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF, EUR/LatAm majors) transacted with an EU-authorised bank under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or the AEB Contractor Master Agreement for Financial Transactions, with a documented underlying commercial exposure and no speculative intent; sizeable exposures confirmed via retrospective hedging policy

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or low-liquidity LatAm currencies (e.g., Argentine peso and, where liquidity is limited, Brazilian real or Chilean peso) referencing accessible reference rates (EMTA/Bloomberg fixing), and executed only against an underlying app-store revenue exposure (EUR-in-asset, non-deliverable leg in local currency)

Cross-currency swaps (EUR versus USD, GBP or selected LatAm currencies) enabling periodic net interest and principal exchanges for intercompany loan balance-sheet hedging, entered into only by the SL where the notional exceeds the NFC+ clearing threshold or via the ISDA/CSA documentation with applicable EMIR compliance and trade-reporting obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts (Cuentas Anuales) comprising Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Statement of Changes in Equity and Notes; Management Report where required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry of the province of the registered office (Registro Mercantil Provincial)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada: shareholders' meeting must approve accounts by 30 June; the approved accounts must be deposited with the Mercantile Registry within one month after approval, normally by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-deposit triggers closure of the Mercantile Registry (cierre registral) preventing registration of eligible corporate acts; monetary penalty imposed by the ICAC under Article 283 of the Spanish Companies Act ranging from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000; continued default may lead to public notification and possible judicial dissolution of the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades – Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months and twenty-five days after the close of the tax period; for a calendar-year SL, from 1 January to 25 July following the tax year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing without prior request incurs a flat surcharge (recargo por presentación extemporánea) of 5% up to 20% of the tax due, plus late-interest; failure to file after formal notice may result in penalties of 50% to 150% of the amount due, with monetary minimums, and enforced collection through embargo of assets when payment remains outstanding

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Informative Return of Transactions with Third Parties (Modelo 347)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of February following the end of the calendar year; next business day if the deadline falls on a public or non-business day
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or incorrect filing of transactions triggers penalties under Article 203 of the General Tax Law, generally EUR 300 minimum and up to 4% or 2% of the omitted transaction amounts depending on the type of omission, plus late-interest if any tax effect arises

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada must undergo a mandatory independent audit if it meets at least two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive financial years: (a) balance sheet total exceeds EUR 2,846,000; (b) annual net turnover exceeds EUR 5,700,000; (c) average workforce exceeds 50 employees. Audit is also compulsory for parent companies required to prepare consolidated accounts, for entities with shareholders holding at least 5% of the share capital requesting audit, and for regulated entities such as credit institutions and insurance undertakings
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Plan General Contable (PGC), the Spanish local GAAP approved by Royal Decree 1514/2007 and subsequent amendments, is mandatory for all Spanish companies; the PGC de PYMES (SMEs) scheme applies to entities below the size thresholds; consolidated financial statements must use EU-adopted International Financial Reporting Standards (EU-IFRS)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 10/2010 and the implementing beneficial-ownership rules, the SL must keep an updated internal record of its ultimate beneficial owners. Any transfer of shares or change in effective control must be recorded in the statutory Register of Members and communicated to the Registro de Titularidades Reales within one month of the change. Annually, the deposit of annual accounts with the Mercantile Registry must include the updated beneficial-owner declaration; the annual accounts filing serves as the confirmation that the previously declared ownership remains valid when no relevant shareholding changes have occurred
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential rates for R&D and innovation activities; accelerated depreciation on qualifying assets

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) via Agencia Tributaria electronic portal (Cl@ve or certificado digital)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days after fiscal year-end (e.g. 20 July for calendar year ending 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents report attributable income; digital services income taxed at source
Subject to 19% WHT unless treaty relief applied
Limited for non-residents without PE; claim via TRC where applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 100 EUR per day up to 3,000 EUR; tax underpayment: 100% of evaded tax plus 100% surcharge and interest

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Treaty Relief Certificate) application to Agencia Tributaria prior to dividend payment; include beneficial ownership certificate and tax residency proof
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 19% on royalties and interest; reduced to 0-15% under applicable DTAs (e.g. 5% royalties under many treaties)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 20 million consolidated group revenue for Master File; EUR 1 million for Local File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain enforces Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) under Law 11/2021; entities holding IP or performing relevant activities must demonstrate adequate substance to avoid recharacterization

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including imprisonment up to 5 years; civil fines equivalent to 100-200% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal criminal liability, disqualification from management, and joint liability for corporate debts

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a company without economic activity or substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Dissolution and fines up to 300,000 EUR; potential criminal liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of corporate veil; directors personally liable for tax obligations and damages

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement KYC/AML procedures or suspicious transaction reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 2 million EUR or 2% of turnover; criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and potential imprisonment for willful non-compliance
